instruction: Find the best definition for the underlined words in the following sentences by choosing A, B, C, D or E.

items.questionText: 1. Since I have a short attention span, I tend to read shorter stories instead of the comprehensive narratives on which they are based.

options.text: proving that you have done something morally wrong or embarrassing, or making it seem as if you have done so
done or made in order to remind people of someone who has died
including all the necessary facts, details, or problems that need to be dealt with
important, interesting, excellent, or unusual enough to be noticed or mentioned
two or more facts, ideas etc. that are closely related or dependent on each other

items.questionText: 2. A fierce quarrel arose regarding whether or not the teenager should be grounded for rude behavior and breaking curfew rules.

options.text: done with a lot of energy and strong feelings, and sometimes violence
able to exist or be used together without causing problems
not at all interested in someone or something
including a wide variety of people, things etc.
used to emphasize that something continues for a long time without any pauses

items.questionText: 3. Farmers are able to get every substance their body needs by obtaining the vitamins and minerals from the foods that they grow.

options.text: something someone does, especially something that is very good or very bad
the regular way in which something happens, develops, or is done
a small piece of thick, rough material which covers part of a floor
a particular type of solid, liquid, gas, or material
a lack of something that is necessary

items.questionText: 4. While few could foresee his initial win, even fewer could predict what this highly unusual president would do in office.

options.text: to think that something is true, although you are not certain
to make it easier for a process or activity to happen
to behave in a dishonest way in order to win or to get an advantage
to be all around someone or something on every side
to think or know that something is going to happen in the future

items.questionText: 5. Parents want their children to succeed in this world, but if they are held back by their peers and a shortage of teachers in the public school system, they won't be able to compete.

options.text: when someone does what they are told to do, or what a law, rule etc. says they must do
a situation in which there is not enough of something that people need
a large amount of something arranged in a shape that looks like a small hill
a government, especially one that was not elected fairly or that you disapprove of for some other reason
something that you add to something else to improve it or make it complete

items.questionText: 6. A flower-covered memorial was placed near the attack site to honor the victims who were gunned down last Sunday.

options.text: something, especially a stone with writing on it, that reminds people of someone who has died
a religious ceremony for burying or cremating (=burning) someone who has died
the strong love that you show when you pay a lot of attention to someone or something
the reason that makes someone do something, especially when this reason is kept hidden
something that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed

items.questionText: To ___________ learning, each class should be no larger than 30 students. In this way, teachers can better focus on the weaknesses of the students.
Why don't you vote - how can you be so ___________ to what is going on in the world?
The city's bus drivers have been on _________ for three weeks. That’s why I am driving to work these days, although I don’t like driving much.
There is no smoking allowed anywhere on school ______________.
Northam made the ______________ at an afternoon news briefing on the coronavirus pandemic.
Some months, like January in the depth of winter, are relatively quiet times, with no urgent problems to _____________. Then, I have some time to read a little bit.
It's difficult to _____________, but most babies can say a few words by the age of 12 months.

instruction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate words from the box. There are TWO extra words. Do NOT change the forms.

items.questionText: If you look at the map carefully, you can see that the Andes form a natural ___________ between Argentina and Chile.
Parents have to be very careful with what they say or how they react when they tackle an undesirable issue since their behaviour has a _____________ effect on their children.
Most teenagers dream about living on their own but they fail to ___________ the difficulties they might encounter when living away from their parents.
The day before the university entrance exam she spent a ____________ night, tossing and turning in bed.

At higher levels it is not enough to learn the ____________ meanings of the words in the wordlist. In order to better comprehend long texts, you are expected to know their figurative meanings as well.
Cheap and clean hotel rooms are generally ______________ in popular cities, especially in summers so if you want to visit such places, you should make a reservation in advance.
It is scientifically proven that as people grow older, they cannot ______________ some sounds.
Security at the football matches has been tightened since last year. ______________, it has been reported that about 1,000 people have managed to get in without ticket in the last three months.
Although the education system is quite challenging, the _____________ majority of our students – nearly 90 percent – graduate within four years.
After two days of continuous rain, towns, and cities all over the country have been _____________ severely.
The living room felt cozy and warm, thanks to the _____________ wallpaper that added depth and character to the walls.
The camouflage outfit helped him blend with his _____________, making it difficult for anyone to spot him in the forest.

instruction: The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the sentences. Fill in each space in this way. Spelling mistakes will be penalized.

items.questionText: Many scientists _________________ that the new damage to the forests is the result of higher levels of pollution. New measures need to be taken immediately. (Base word: PRESUMABLY)
Since I bought a software package that is ____________ with my laptop’s operating system, I will have to return it and buy a suitable one for my laptop. (Base word: COMPATIBLE)
The school has a strong culture of ________________ of students with special needs. They want every student to take part in the same activities and enjoy themselves. (Base word: INCLUDE)
Barcelona won’t have Arturo Vidal or Sergio Busquets due to ______________, and I think Ousmane Dembélé may still be recovering from injury. (Base word: SUSPEND)
The hotel is situated in a peaceful ______________ neighbourhood. (Base word: RESIDENCE)
At university, you must be prepared to take ___________. You may not always find somebody to tell you what to do. (Base word: INITIATE)
If the hairstylist and makeup artist work ____________, they will have the bride ready on time despite her late arrival to the venue. (Base word: SIMULTANEOUS)
As poverty and poor housing ___________ with shorter life expectancy, the government needs to increase the life standards of its citizens living in poor suburbs. (Base word: CORRELATION)
What level in the ___________ structure do you want to be at? At the top or somewhere in the middle? (Base word: HIERARCHY)
In the singing competition there are several talented performers, most ____________ the purple-haired woman with the angelic voice. (Base word: NOTABLE)
When you are dealing with so many patients, mistakes are ____________ to happen. Don’t feel bad! (Base word: BIND)
Try to satisfy your ___________ with raw veggies and fruit rather than croissants. (Base word: HUNGRY)

instruction: Fill in the table with an appropriate word from the box to make a collocation.

items.questionText: What word collocates with 'consider', 'discuss', 'examine' to form a common phrase? (e.g., consider ______)
What word collocates with 'have', 'require', 'lack'? (e.g., have ______)
What word collocates with 'hint of', 'a trace of', 'touch of'? (e.g., hint of ______)
What word collocates with 'swear', 'demand' (e.g., demand ______); and is described by 'blind', 'unquestioning', 'absolute/complete'? (e.g., blind ______)
What verb collocates with 'a problem/issue', 'a job/challenge', 'crime', 'poverty', 'unemployment'? (e.g., ______ a problem)
What verb collocates with 'power', 'control', 'a chance', 'an opportunity', 'the initiative'? (e.g., ______ power)
What adjective collocates with 'impact', 'effect', 'changes'? (e.g., ______ impact)
What word collocates with 'set', 'define', 'establish', 'consider'? (e.g., set ______)
What word completes the phrases 'Within the …' and 'Out of …'? (e.g., within the ______)
What word collocates with 'reach', 'come to', 'arrive at'? (e.g., reach a ______)
